title: Read-only access for the council auditors

articles.subject: Read-only access for the council auditors
articles.body:
Hi,

Our elected auditors will review the spring grant round in October. They need to read cases and decisions but must not be able to change anything, and it should be visible in the log that they only read.

Is there a ready-made role for that, or do we build one? Three named people, access needed from 1 October.

--
Per Ek
IT, Nordstad kommun
per.ek@nordstad.se | 070-555 21 08
